I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands, do hereby declare, underSub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that thelands described below are needed for a public purpose and will beacquired under the provisions of that Act.

01. Lot No. 1 – Makumbura Welyaya – Extent: 0.4198 HectareNorth: Assmt. Nos. 90/94 and 90/95, Raja Mawatha and Canal;East: Canal; South: Lot No. 2, Assmt. No. 27/50, Nidahas Mawathaand Assmt. No. not known claimed by P. G. Gamini and others,Nidahas Mawatha; West: Lot No. 2, Assmt. No. 27/50, NidahasMawatha, Assmt. No. not known claimed by P. G. Gaminiand others, Nidahas Mawatha and Assmt. Nos. 90/94 and 90/95,Raja Mawatha.

02. Lot No. 2 – Makumbura Welyaya – Extent: 0.3176 HectareNorth: Lot No. 1 and Canal; East: Lot No. 1, Canal, Lot Nos. 4and 3; South: Lot Nos. 4, 3 and Assmt. No. 27/50, Nidahas Mawatha;West: Lot No. 3, Assmt. No. 27/50, Nidahas Mawatha and LotNo. 1.
